summary: Frontend-only pinball game tested end-to-end. Verified the previously reported bug ('ball not appearing/interacting after launch') is FIXED: ball is now clearly visible in the launcher chute with a glow, launches successfully via both SPACE and the new LANÇAR mouse button, decrements ball count, and reaches GAME OVER after 3 balls. However a secondary gameplay concern was observed: across 3 consecutive ball launches the score stayed at 000000, indicating the ball's trajectory from the chute deflector consistently bypasses all scoring elements (bumpers, slingshots, lanes, targets, spinner).

integration_issues.issue: Across 3 consecutive launches (SPACE + LANÇAR mouse hold) the score never increased from 000000. Ball counter decremented properly (3->2->1->0) and BOLA PERDIDA / GAME OVER flows worked, but the ball never registered a bumper, slingshot, drop-target, lane-sensor, or spinner hit. Likely the launched ball's post-deflector trajectory (vy=-26 launch with the (LAUNCH_WALL_X,50)->(W,100) deflector) sends the ball too far up-left, bouncing along the top/left walls and funneling straight to the drain without crossing any pop bumper. Consider: (a) reducing launch max power, (b) adjusting deflector angle, (c) adding a guide rail that forces ball into bumper cluster, or (d) lowering pop-bumper Y positions so at least one is in the ball's typical descent path.

issues: 'SEGURE ESPACO' hint text is drawn at x=ball.x-30 which places it partially outside the right edge of the canvas (canvas W=480, ball x≈461). Text is clipped as visible in screenshots — should be repositioned to the LEFT of the ball inside canvas bounds, or arrow/label placed at ball.x-40 with textAlign='right'.

action_items: Investigate ball trajectory post-launch: launched ball misses ALL scoring elements — score stays 0 across full 3-ball game. Tune plunger max power, deflector geometry, or bumper positions so a typical launch produces at least one bumper/lane hit.
Reposition on-canvas 'SEGURE ESPACO' hint so it is not clipped by the right edge of the canvas (currently drawn at ball.x with textAlign=center at x≈461 on a 480-wide canvas).
critical_code_review_comments: Pinball.jsx is 1434 lines in a single file — consider splitting physics, rendering, and React shell into separate modules for maintainability.

Ball launch parameters (MAX_SPEED=30, plunger cap=26, vx=-0.6) combined with the diagonal deflector produce a nearly-fixed leftward-upward trajectory that appears to consistently avoid all bumpers. Add unit-testable trajectory sampling or tune constants.
In-canvas hint 'SEGURE ESPACO' at ball.x with textAlign=center is clipped by canvas edge when ball is in launcher (ball.x≈461, W=480). Move to left side of ball.

MAX_SPEED=30 with per-frame movement of 26+ pixels risks tunneling despite the substep loop (BALL_R*0.5=6, substeps=ceil(30/6)=5 → 6px per substep is right at the limit for BALL_R=12 walls). Consider substeps based on BALL_R*0.3.
getImageData warning in console: canvas is not created with willReadFrequently=true (only affects performance of external tests, not gameplay).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all UI and launch flows work; only scoring interaction is unreliable)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The user-reported visibility/launch bug is verified fixed. The remaining concern is trajectory tuning so that a normal launch actually hits scoring elements — main agent may want to reduce plunger cap (e.g. from 26 back toward 18-22), adjust deflector segment endpoints, or reposition bumpers. Also note: LANÇAR button is at approximately (895,980)-(1025,1060) on a 1920x1080 viewport and works via mouse.down/up (tested with page.mouse.down/up over a 1.2s hold, produced yellowPixelsInPowerBar=1695 while charging). Ball spawn/appearance is verified via canvas pixel sampling: 101 bright pixels near (461,720) confirms the ball with glow is rendered. Console shows only a getImageData willReadFrequently warning (from the test harness pixel sampling), no other JS errors.
rca of the issue: Original bug 'ball not appearing/not interacting': RCA confirms visibility fix works — increased radius (12), glow aura, trail, and 'SEGURE ESPACO' hint successfully make ball visually obvious. LANÇAR mouse button correctly wires onMouseDown->keysRef.launch=true, triggering the same plungerPower charge as SPACE. Ball state transitions (onLaunch=true -> vy=-plungerPower -> onLaunch=false) fire correctly and ball counter decrements confirming physics loop runs. New secondary issue (score stays 0): launched ball with vy up to -26 followed by deflector reflection produces trajectory (vx≈-21, vy≈-6 at deflection point) that carries the ball into the far top-left of the playfield, then it appears to funnel down the left wall guide directly to the drain, missing bumpers at y=170-300.
